scope: Controller JSON decoding only; no SSH, native UI, model, disk or network benchmark

methodology.warmup: one full verified decode before timing; Worker startup is outside these warm samples
methodology.timedWork: UTF-8 decoding and JSON parsing; Worker return cloning included
methodology.workerLifetime: one reusable bounded Worker; 30-second idle retirement
methodology.limitation: Timer scheduling is sampled, not a profiler; Worker startup, buffer copies, result cloning and GC still cost time.
